errors.evidence: The description states the value for the 25-34 age group in Germany is about 12%, but the bar is visibly higher, at approximately 13%.
The description states the value for the 25-34 age group in the USA is about 17%, but the bar is exactly on the 17.5% mark (halfway between 15 and 20).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous and partially contradicts an earlier correct statement. While the bar values are not sorted, the categories (countries) on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically ('Deutschland', 'Niederlande', 'USA'), which the description correctly noted earlier. This sentence creates confusion about what is or isn't sorted.
